desc: Build an untethered-boot object carrying the Ubuntu 24.04 RAM root, now that the enrolled-object ceiling is measured at >=64 MiB fully loaded (done/2026-07-25-t6040-object-size-ceiling.md) and 16 KiB page alignment is enforced. Reuse the live-proven pieces: diet kernel Image-b0-diet.xz (4.68 MiB), storage-disabled DTB 2782b922, and initramfs-ubuntu-ramroot-no.cpio.gz 0987cb7c (29 MB, glibc, Norwegian keymap, held-fd watchdog ping) — re-compress the initramfs as minilzlib-safe xz (-9e --check=crc32 -T1) to shrink it. Projected object ~30-35 MiB, comfortably inside the proven ceiling. Verify with the strict verifier (which now sees the auto page-padding), smoke it via TETHERED chainload first, then propose enrollment for a maintainer-run cold boot. Pass = Ubuntu userspace on the internal panel untethered, Norwegian keymap loaded, watchdog fed, empty partitions. Offline build; enrollment is 1TR-only and maintainer-executed.
author: claude
